question: The analyst found the correlation to be ____ insignificant to alter conclusions.
solution:
The correct answer is '**too**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**too**" is used to indicate an excessive degree or extent, which perfectly fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The sentence conveys that the correlation is excessively insignificant to make any changes to the conclusions.
 
• **Options 2, 3, 4**, and 5 are grammatically or contextually incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The analyst found the correlation to be **too**__ insignificant to alter conclusions."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "quite"** is incorrect because it does not convey the idea of excess.
 
• **Option 3: "so"** is incorrect as it does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "as"** is incorrect because it does not imply the required degree of insignificance.
